subject: [Question] Can sec_axis be used to add more than one secondary axis?

messages.author: 17d049859bf8ae3f
messages.subject: [Question] Can sec_axis be used to add more than one secondary axis?
parts: I am trying to plot data from USGS stream gages and would like to include discharge, temperature and turbidity over time. These all use different scales so I would like to add 2 additional y-axis. I have fooled around a little, and have successfully added a secondary axis, but I can not get a tertiary axis to graph as well. I would really like to do this in ggplot2 as I plan to animate this figure as a part of a presentation. Thank you in advance for your help.

messages.author: b522e2cd42e4abeb
messages.subject: Re: [Question] Can sec_axis be used to add more than one secondary axis?
parts:
You can just add a vertical line as the third axis: geom_vline()
For the number you need to scale it to be in line with the primary axis.

It can have its own scale as long as you adjust the number in respective data seiries.
